meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.

howto.what: 把某个 NanoClaw 代理组的请求从 Anthropic API 改指向本机 Ollama 模型。它会写入 container.json 的环境变量、在共享 settings.json 里设置模型名,并重启服务,让代理用本地模型运行。
howto.when: 当你想让代理在本机运行、减少 API 费用,或试用开放权重模型时使用。前提是 Ollama 已安装并运行、已拉取模型,且代理组已存在。

howto.what_en: Switches one NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a local Ollama model. It writes env vars in container.json, sets the model in the shared settings.json, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an agent group to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama running with a pulled model and an existing agent group.

say_en.note: It edits container.json and settings.json, then restarts.
